title: NVIDIA releases DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering for Hogwarts Legacy
excerpt: The update introduces neural rendering technology to the game on the GeForce NOW cloud gaming platform.
bodyHtml:
NVIDIA announced on November 5, 2026, that Hogwarts Legacy has received an update featuring NVIDIA DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering. This technology is designed to provide lifelike lighting and material detail while maintaining the underlying geometry and textures of the game.

The integration, developed by Avalanche Software, includes support for DLSS Multi Frame Generation and Ray Reconstruction to enhance ray-traced graphics. Avalanche Software has tuned the integration through DLSS 5 developer controls to maintain the game artistic intent and style.

GeForce NOW members can access these features across various devices, including PCs, Macs, and handhelds. Ultimate members receive performance equivalent to GeForce RTX 5080-class hardware without requiring a PC upgrade.

The cloud platform handles all game installs and updates for members. This service allows users to save storage space for other essentials while accessing the updated game.
